blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-parametric MRI is the gold standard for neuro-oncology, yet acquiring complete 4-modality protocols may be unfeasible in real-world clinical practice. When handling missing modalities, existing automated systems force a critical compromise: robust segmenters operate as uninterpretable "black boxes" that bypass image generation, while standard synthesis models often produce blurry reconstructions lacking diagnostic reliability. To address this issue, we propose CAPS, a Clinically-Verifiable Anatomy-Prioritized Synthesis framework that reconciles computational precision with clinical transparency. Our multi-modal generative architecture is driven by a hybrid objective function (L_1 + L_AFP + L_DualDice) that explicitly enforces the preservation of deep anatomical features and strict topological boundaries, rather than relying solely on pixel-wise optimization. Evaluated comprehensively on the BraTS Adult Glioma dataset, the framework achieves superior synthesis fidelity across intensity-based metrics, and demonstrates robust downstream segmentation performance (82.38% mean Dice), successfully restoring verifiable visual context. Furthermore, the framework exhibits exceptional zero-shot cross-domain generalization, maintaining high structural fidelity across completely unseen Meningioma, Pediatric, and Sub-Saharan African cohorts without domain-specific adaptation. Finally, a blinded radiological assessment confirms that our anatomy-aware approach significantly enhances both perceived image quality and clinical utility, providing clinicians with the reliable visual evidence required to trust downstream automated workflows.
blocks.zh: 多参数 核磁共振是神经肿瘤学的金本位,但获得完整的4模式协议在现实世界的临床实践中可能不可行. 在处理缺失模式时,现有的自动化系统迫使一个关键的折中方案: 强力的分区器作为无法解释的"黑匣子"运行,绕过图像生成,而标准合成模型往往产生缺乏诊断可靠性的模糊重建. 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用CAPS这一临床可验证的解剖学优先合成框架,使计算精度与临床透明度相协调。 我们的多模式基因结构是由混合目标函数(L_1 + L_AFP + L_DualDice)驱动的,它明确强制保护深解剖特征和严格的地形界限,而不是完全依赖像素优化. 对BrATS Adult Glioma数据集进行了全面评估,该框架实现了基于强度的衡量尺度的超强合成忠诚度,并展示了强力的下游分解性能(82.38%指Dice),成功恢复了可核查的视觉环境. 此外,该框架展现出非凡的零镜头跨域通用,在完全不为人知的梅宁吉欧马、小儿科和撒哈拉以南非洲组别中保持高结构的忠诚度,而不对具体领域进行调整。 最后,一项盲目的放射评估证实,我们的解剖意识方法大大提高了所感知的图像质量和临床效用,为临床医生提供了相信下游自动化工作流程所需的可靠视觉证据.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Gliomas are among the most prevalent primary Central Nervous System (CNS) tumors Weller et al. (2015) , with high-grade gliomas being particularly aggressive due to their highly infiltrative growth and low survival rates Guo et al. (2023) . The gold standard for the diagnosis, treatment planning, and post-operative monitoring of these tumors is multi-parametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging (mp-MRI). A standard neuro-oncological protocol typically comprises four scan modalities: Native T1-weighted (T1n), Post-contrast T1-weighted (T1c), T2-weighted (T2w), and T2 Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery (T2f) Diana-Albelda et al. (2025a) . Each modality provides unique and complementary tissue contrasts that are critical for accurate tumor characterization. For instance, the active, proliferating tumor core and neoangiogenesis are primarily visible in the gadolinium-enhanced T1c sequence, while the surrounding peritumoral edema and non-enhancing infiltrative regions are best delineated using T2f. However, acquiring the complete 4-modality protocol in real-world clinical settings is sometimes unfeasible, as scans may be incomplete due to time constraints, patient motion artifacts, financial limitations, or contraindications to gadolinium-based contrast agents Li et al. (2024) . The absence of even a single modality introduces a twofold clinical and algorithmic challenge. Clinically, it deprives neuroradiologists of vital anatomical information, potentially leading to suboptimal surgical planning and, ultimately, negatively impacting patient survival and recurrence rates. Algorithmically, state-of-the-art automated segmentation systems, which are increasingly integrated to assist clinical workflows, are typically designed to process the full set of four input channels, thereby experiencing severe performance degradation or failure when a modality is missing or zero-padded Sharma and Hamarneh (2019) .
blocks.zh: Gliomas是最普遍的中枢神经系统肿瘤(CNS) Weller等人(2015年)之一,高级胶原瘤因其高度渗入性生长和郭等人(2023年)存活率低而特别具有攻击性。 这些肿瘤的诊断,治疗规划和术后监测的黄金标准是多参数磁共振成像(mp-MRI). 标准的神经肿瘤协议通常包括四种扫描方式: 原生T1加权(T1n),后相撞T1加权(T1c),T2加权(T2w),以及T2流体反转恢复(T2f) Diana-Albelda等人(2025a). 每种模式都提供了独特和互补的组织对比,对准确的肿瘤特征描述至关重要。 例如,活跃、扩散的肿瘤核和新阳性主要可见于加多利尼姆增强型T1c序列,而周围的直肠水肿和不增强型渗入区则最好使用T2f来划定。 然而,在现实世界临床环境中获得完整的4模式协议有时并不可行,因为扫描可能由于时间限制,病人运动文物,财政限制,或者对基于加多利nium的对比剂Li等人(2024年)的禁忌而不完整. 连单一模式都不存在,这带来了临床和算法两方面的挑战。 在临床上,它剥夺了神经辐射学家重要的解剖学信息,可能导致手术规划不优化,并最终对病人的生存和复发率产生不利影响。 算法上,最先进的自动化分解系统日益集成,以协助临床工作流程,一般设计用于处理全套四个输入通道,从而在缺少一种模式或零加成的夏尔马和哈马纳(2019年)时发生严重性能退化或故障.

blocks.en: To mitigate this problem, two main strategies have emerged in the literature. The first one focuses on designing robust segmentation frameworks that can predict tumor boundaries despite incomplete inputs Zhang et al. (2022) ; Pipoli et al. (2025) . While these systems achieve remarkable accuracy, they present a significant challenge in clinical practice: they output a tumor mask without restoring the missing anatomical image, leaving the clinician without the visual evidence needed to corroborate the automated delineation. The second strategy relies on image synthesis to impute the missing modality Diana-Albelda et al. (2025b) . However, traditional synthesis methods primarily optimize standard pixel-wise reconstruction losses, such as L1, which frequently results in blurry outputs that miss important structural details Longuefosse et al. (2025) , thereby restricting their practical utility for the clinicians.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这一问题,文献中出现了两个主要战略。 第一部分侧重于设计能预测肿瘤边界的强性分解框架,尽管投入不完整的张等人(2022年);皮波利等人(2025年). 虽然这些系统取得了显著的准确性,但它们在临床实践中提出了重大挑战:它们在不恢复缺失的解剖图像的情况下输出肿瘤面罩,使临床医生没有证实自动划界所需的视觉证据。 第二种策略依赖于图像合成,将缺失的模式Diana-Albelda et al. (2025b). 然而,传统的合成方法主要优化标准像素-视像素重建损失,如L1,经常导致输出模糊,错过了重要的结构细节Longuefosse等人(2025年),从而限制了其对临床医生的实用性.

blocks.en: Addressing these limitations, we propose CAPS, a novel Clinically-Verifiable Anatomy-Prioritized Synthesis framework that bridges the gap between computational robustness and clinical reliability. Instead of optimizing solely for pixel-level similarity, our approach explicitly maximizes the preservation of anatomical structures and tumor topology. By restoring the missing modality with high structural fidelity, our method provides the clinician with the necessary visual data to plan surgeries and verify AI-generated segmentations, while simultaneously supporting robust downstream automated segmentation, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 针对这些局限性,我们提出CAPS, 一个新的临床可验证解剖学优先合成框架, 弥合计算稳健性和临床可靠性之间的差距。 我们的方法不是仅仅为了像素水平的相似性而优化,而是明确最大限度地保护解剖结构和肿瘤地形。 如图1所示,通过恢复结构高度忠实的缺失模式,我们的方法为临床医生提供了必要的视觉数据,以规划手术和核实AI生成的片段,同时支持强大的下游自动片段。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of CAPS. Given three available MRI modalities ( 𝒳 \mathcal{X} : T1n, T2w, T2f), the generator G G synthesizes the missing sequence ( Y ^ \hat{Y} , T1c in this example). The synthesized volume is then concatenated with the available modalities and fed into the clinical segmenter S S , which produces the predicted tumor mask ( Z ^ \hat{Z} ) for the three nested BraTS regions (WT, TC, ENH). Moreover, the synthesized volume is provided to a radiologist for blinded clinical validation, ensuring that the framework delivers both automated segmentation and verifiable visual context.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: 1. Empirical Analysis of the Accuracy-Interpretability Trade-off. We compare robust segmentation frameworks against synthesis-based pipelines and conclude that, while robust segmenters may achieve marginally higher numerical accuracy on missing modalities, high-fidelity image synthesis is an indispensable step to provide the visual context that neuroradiologists require for diagnostic verification. 2. Anatomy-Prioritized Synthesis. Unlike traditional approaches that rely solely on pixel-wise optimization, we design a generative architecture driven by a hybrid loss function ( ℒ 1 + ℒ A ​ F ​ P + ℒ D ​ u ​ a ​ l ​ D ​ i ​ c ​ e \mathcal{L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP}+\mathcal{L}_{DualDice} ) that explicitly enforces the preservation of fine anatomical structures, tumor boundaries, and overall integrity. Building upon the AFP loss originally proposed for MR-to-CT translation Longuefosse et al. (2025) , we adapt it to the multi-modal MRI synthesis setting and complement it with a Dual Dice loss that jointly penalizes region-level and boundary-level deviations. Central to our design is a frozen, modality-specialized segmentation network that serves a dual supervisory role: as a multi-scale anatomical feature extractor and as a topological boundary enforcer, directly coupling the generative objective with downstream diagnostic consistency. 3. Blinded Radiological Evaluation. Moving beyond standard pixel-level metrics (e.g., PSNR, NMSE) that may not fully reflect clinical utility, we incorporate a blinded clinical validation. We conclude that our CAPS approach yields synthetic images with improved diagnostic quality and structural reliability compared to the standard synthesis baseline. To facilitate reproducibility and encourage clinical validation in future synthesis research, we publicly release the evaluation tool used for this assessment. 4. Cross-Domain Generalization. We successfully evaluate the synthesis capability of our method on completely unseen Meningioma, Pediatric Glioma, and Sub-Saharan Glioma datasets, effectively overcoming the domain shift without requiring any domain-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 1. 准确性-可解释性权衡的经验分析。 我们比较了强性分解框架和基于合成的管道,并得出结论,虽然强性分解器可能在缺失模式上实现略高的数值精确度,但高真实度图像合成是提供神经辐射学家诊断验证所需的视觉环境的一个不可或缺的步骤。 2. 解剖学优先综合。 与仅依靠像素优化的传统方法不同,我们设计了由混合损失函数驱动的基因结构(L 1 + L A F P + L D a l D i c e \ mathcal{ L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP}+\mathcal{L}_{DualDice})明确强制保存精细解剖结构,肿瘤边界,以及整体完整性. 根据最初为MR-CT翻译Longuefosse等人(2025年)提出的AFP损失,我们根据多式磁共振合成设置加以调整,并辅之以双重双虱损失,共同惩罚区域一级和边界一级的偏差。 我们设计的中心是冷冻的、模式化的专门分块网络,它发挥双重监督作用:作为多尺度解剖特征提取器和地形边界执行器,将基因目标与下游诊断一致性直接结合。 3. 盲辐射评价。 超越标准像素级的度量衡(如PSNR,NMSE),可能无法充分体现临床实用性,我们包含了盲目的临床验证. 我们的结论是,与标准合成基线相比,我们的CAPS方法产生更好的诊断质量和结构可靠性的合成图像。 为了促进可再生产性,并鼓励在未来的合成研究中进行临床验证,我们公开发布用于这一评估的评估工具. 4. 跨领域通用。 我们成功地在完全看不见的Meningioma、Pediatric Glioma和撒哈拉以南的Glioma数据集上评估了我们方法的合成能力,有效地克服了域位变化,而不需要任何特定域位的调整。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Handling missing mp-MRI modalities in neuro-oncology generally falls into two distinct paradigms: robust segmentation architectures that adapt to incomplete inputs Zhang et al. (2024) , and medical image synthesis models that generate the absent data Dar et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: 在神经-肿瘤学中处理缺失的mp-MRI模式一般属于两个不同的范式: 适应不完整输入的强分化结构 Zhang等人(2024年),以及生成缺漏数据的医疗图像合成模型Dar等人(2019年).

blocks.en: 2.1 Robust Segmentation with Missing Modalities
blocks.zh: 2.1 与缺失模式的有力分割

blocks.en: Recent literature has extensively explored adaptive segmentation networks designed to be resilient against incomplete input configurations. Several studies have focused on learning modality-agnostic networks and shared latent representations that remain stable even when specific sequences are omitted Dorent et al. (2019) . For instance, early foundational approaches like HeMIS Havaei et al. (2016) achieved this by computing statistical moments across available feature maps. This concept has evolved into sophisticated feature-level fusion strategies employing attention mechanisms, transformer-based architectures like mmFormer Zhang et al. (2022) , and state-space models such as IM-Fuse Pipoli et al. (2025) . Additionally, knowledge distillation techniques have been widely proposed to transfer structural information from a full-modality “teacher” network to a missing-modality “student” network Hu et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 近期文献广泛探索了适应性分割网络,旨在抵御不完整输入配置. 一些研究侧重于学习模式-不可知性网络和共享的潜在表述,即使省略了特定的序列Dorent等人(2019年)。 例如,HEMIS Havaei等人(2016年)等早期基础方法通过计算现有地物图的统计时刻来实现这一目标。 这一概念演变为运用关注机制的精密地貌级聚变策略,基于变压器的架构如mmFormer Zhang等人(2022年),以及IM-Fuse Pipoli等人(2025年)等状态空间模型. 此外,还广泛建议采用知识蒸馏技术,将结构信息从全模式的“教师”网络转移到缺失模式的“学生”网络Hu等人(2020年)。

blocks.en: Despite achieving remarkably high computational accuracy, typically evaluated through standard metrics like the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) and Hausdorff Distance (HD95), these robust segmenters face a critical usability limitation. Because they do not generate the missing scan and directly predict tissue boundaries, they fail to provide the structural reference that radiologists rely on. This lack of diagnostic transparency hinders the adoption of pure segmentation approaches in clinical workflows where visual verification is mandatory.
blocks.zh: 尽管计算精度非常高,通常通过Dice相似性系数(DSC)和Hausdorff距离(HD95)等标准衡量标准加以评估,但这些强力的分电机面临着关键的可用性限制。 由于它们不会产生缺失的扫描并直接预测组织边界,因此无法提供放射学家所依赖的结构参考. 这种缺乏诊断透明度的情况阻碍了临床工作流程中采用纯分化方法,而视觉核查则是强制性的。

blocks.en: 2.2 Medical Image Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.2 医疗图像合成

blocks.en: A parallel line of research focuses on cross-modality medical image synthesis to impute the missing sequences. Early generative methods heavily relied on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) Goodfellow et al. (2014) ; Tavse et al. (2022) ; Al Khalil et al. (2024) , such as Pix2Pix Isola et al. (2017) and CycleGAN Zhu et al. (2017) , which primarily performed one-to-one image translations. More recently, the field has advanced towards highly adaptable architectures capable of handling multi-modal inputs, shifting from basic 1-to-1 mappings to complex many-to-one synthesis models Meng et al. (2024) . This evolution is highlighted by advanced Diffusion Models Kebaili et al. (2025b) like AMM-Diff Kebaili et al. (2025a) , which adaptively process variable sets of inputs, and State Space Models like I2I-Mamba Atli et al. (2024) , which capture long-range contextual features across multi-contrast MRI.
blocks.zh: 一个平行的研究线侧重于跨模式的医学图像合成,以对缺失的序列进行分类. 早期遗传学方法严重依赖基因遗传学辅助网络 Goodfellow等人(2014年);Tavse等人(2022年);Al Khalil等人(2024年),如Pix2Pix Isola等人(2017年)和CycleGAN Zhu等人(2017年),主要进行一对一图像翻译. 最近,该领域已逐步走向能够处理多模式投入的高度适应性架构,从基本的1:1绘图转向复杂的多对一合成模型Meng等人(2024年)。 这一演变由先进的扩散模型Kebaili等人(2025年b),如AMM-Diff Kebaili等人(2025年a),这些模型可适应地处理各种可变输入,以及I2I-Mamba Atli等人(2024年)等国家空间模型,这些模型捕捉了跨多孔性磁共振的远程背景特征。

blocks.en: However, a fundamental limitation persists: most of these models are trained using generic pixel intensity-based objectives like L 1 L_{1} or Mean Squared Error Nie et al. (2018) . Because these losses penalize errors on a purely pixel basis, they lack structural awareness and tend to over-smooth the generated images, washing out critical high-frequency details such as intricate tumor borders Isola et al. (2017) . Furthermore, their performance is often solely measured via Image Quality Metrics (e.g., PSNR, SSIM), leaving their actual utility for downstream automated clinical tasks unverified.
blocks.zh: 然而,一个根本的限制依然存在:这些模型大多是使用通用像素强度目标如L1 L_{1}或Mean Squared Error Nie等人(2018年)进行训练。 由于这些损失纯粹在像素基础上惩罚错误,因此它们缺乏结构意识,并倾向于过度疏导生成的图像,从而冲掉了复杂的肿瘤边界Isola等人(2017年)等关键高频细节。 此外,它们的性能往往完全通过图像质量度量仪(例如PSNR,SSIM)进行测量,使得它们对于下游自动化临床任务的实际用途得不到验证.

blocks.en: 2.3 Structural Constraints and Joint Architectures
blocks.zh: 2.3 结构性制约和联合结构

blocks.en: To mitigate the smoothing effects of intensity-based losses, recent studies have introduced structural constraints and joint synthesis-segmentation frameworks. For example, methods like EaGAN Yu et al. (2019) explicitly integrate edge-aware perceptual constraints to preserve high-frequency structures. Similarly, 3D Wavelet Diffusion Models (WDM) Ferreira et al. (2024) strive to maintain spatial resolution while generating missing modalities. Moreover, unified frameworks have been proposed to jointly optimize synthesis and segmentation, acknowledging that image generation must ultimately be useful for tumor delineation Dorent et al. (2025) . However, while feature-based objectives like perceptual loss effectively balance pixel accuracy and realism in natural scenes, they often lack the anatomical rigor required for 3D medical volumes, where structural integrity must be prioritized over stylistic consistency Longuefosse et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 为了减轻强度损失的平滑效应,最近的研究引入了结构限制和联合综合-分块框架。 例如,EaGAN Yu等方法. (2019年)明确整合边缘感知约束,保留高频结构. 同样, 3D波纹扩散模型(WDM) Ferreira等人(2024年)努力保持空间分辨率,同时生成缺失模式. 此外,还提议采用统一框架,共同优化合成和分解,承认图像生成最终必须有助于对多伦特等人的肿瘤划界(2025年)。 然而,虽然基于特征的目标如知觉损失在自然场景中有效地平衡了像素的准确性和现实性,但它们往往缺乏3D医学卷所需的解剖强度,其中结构完整性必须优先于结构一致性Longuefosse等人(2025年).

blocks.en: Despite these significant advances, existing joint frameworks often struggle to preserve fine tissue interfaces when critical modalities are missing. Our work addresses this exact issue. By integrating a targeted Anatomical Feature-Prioritized (AFP) loss and a Dual Dice loss into a multi-modal 3-to-1 generative architecture, our framework successfully reconciles algorithmic precision with clinical interpretability. This approach successfully delivers highly verifiable restorations for radiologists while maintaining competitive performance in subsequent segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些重大进步,但现有的联合框架在缺少关键方式时往往难以保存精细的组织界面。 我们的工作涉及这个问题。 通过将定向解剖特征优先损失(AFP)和双虱损失(Dual Dice)纳入多模式3:1基因结构,我们的框架成功地调和了算法精度和临床可解释性。 这种方法成功地为放射科医生提供了可高度核查的修复,同时在随后的分解任务中保持了竞争性的性能.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: This section details the proposed Clinically-Verifiable Anatomy-Prioritized Synthesis framework (CAPS), designed to impute missing MRI modalities while preserving high-fidelity structural details. First, the mathematical problem formulation and the overall two-stage pipeline are established. Subsequently, the network architecture and the hybrid objective function are introduced. Finally, the specific implementation and training configurations required to ensure robust convergence and downstream clinical utility are outlined.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了拟议的临床可验证解剖学优先合成框架(CAPS),旨在对缺失的核磁共振模式进行估算,同时保留高纯度结构细节. 第一,建立数学问题表述和整体两级管道. 随后,引入网络架构和混合目标功能. 最后,还概述了确保有力的趋同和下游临床效用所需的具体实施和培训配置。

blocks.en: This two-stage pipeline guarantees that the synthesis process is not evaluated in isolation, but rather through its ability to provide actionable and interpretable visual data that supports robust downstream clinical tasks.

blocks.en: It is important to note that, since each MRI sequence encodes fundamentally different tissue contrasts, both the generator G G and the auxiliary extractor S a ​ u ​ x S_{aux} are independently trained for each specific missing modality scenario t ∈ ℳ t\in\mathcal{M} , yielding four specialized pairs ( G t G_{t} , S a ​ u ​ x , t S_{aux,t} ). In contrast, the final clinical segmenter S S is trained as a single unified model capable of processing any imputed 4-modality protocol, regardless of which sequence was synthesized. This design ensures that each synthesis pathway is maximally specialized for its target modality, while the downstream segmenter remains a general-purpose clinical tool.

blocks.en: 3.2 CAPS Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 联合呼吁程序 概览

blocks.en: The proposed method is organized into three distinct components designed to prioritize anatomical fidelity: a generative trainable network G G , an auxiliary feature extractor 𝒮 a ​ u ​ x \mathcal{S}_{aux} , and a final clinical segmenter S S . This tripartite design ensures that the synthesis process is guided by deep anatomical priors while remaining robust for downstream diagnostic tasks.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法分为三个不同的部分,旨在排列解剖忠贞的先后顺序:可基因训练的网络GG,辅助特性提取器S a u x\ mathcal{S}_{aux},以及最后的临床分机S S. 这种三方设计确保合成过程以深解剖学前科为指导,同时对下游诊断任务保持稳健.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Generator ( G G )
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 发电机(GG)

blocks.en: The generator consists of a 3D Residual U-Net (nnResU-Net) Isensee et al. (2024) architecture configured with six encoding and decoding stages.
blocks.zh: 生成器包括一个3D剩余U-Net(nnResU-Net)Isensee等人(2024年)架构,配置有六个编码和解码阶段.

blocks.en: By incorporating residual connections within each convolutional block, the network facilitates an efficient gradient flow that prevents the vanishing gradient problem typical of deep 3D models Isensee et al. (2021) , thereby accelerating convergence and enhancing the stability of the generative process. The encoder is designed to process a multi-channel stacked input 𝒳 \mathcal{X} , composed of the three available MRI modalities, while the decoder is responsible for synthesizing the single-channel volume Y ^ \hat{Y} corresponding to the missing sequence. To prevent the emergence of chequerboard artifacts, the decoder utilizes a trilinear interpolation strategy followed by standard convolutions Longuefosse et al. (2026) , ensuring smooth spatial transitions in the reconstructed anatomy.
blocks.zh: 通过将剩余连接纳入每个演化区块,该网络促进高效的梯度流,防止深层立体模型Isensee等人(2021年)典型的消失梯度问题,从而加快趋同,增强基因过程的稳定性。 编码器旨在处理一个多通道堆叠的输入 X\ mathcal{X} ,由三种可用的核磁共振模式组成,而解码器则负责合成单通道卷 Y^\ hat{Y}对应缺失序列. 为了防止支票板文物的出现,解码器采用了三线插图策略,然后是标准演化Longuefosse等人. (2026),确保重建的解剖学中空间平稳过渡.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the Synthesis Framework. A trainable generator G G synthesizes the missing modality ( Y ^ \hat{Y} , T1c in this example) from the available ones ( 𝒳 \mathcal{X} : T1n, T2w, T2f) through a hybrid objective function. First, a pixel-level ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} loss enforces global intensity consistency between the synthesized volume Y ^ \hat{Y} and the real one Y Y . Then, both are processed by a frozen pre-trained auxiliary segmenter ( S a ​ u ​ x S_{aux} ), which acts as an expert feature extractor to compute the Anatomical Feature-Prioritized ( ℒ A ​ F ​ P \mathcal{L}_{AFP} ) loss across multi-scale latent representations. Finally, the predicted mask ( Z ^ a ​ u ​ x \hat{Z}_{aux} ) and the real one ( Z Z ) are used to calculate the topological Dual Dice loss, thereby ensuring the preservation of both deep structural invariants and precise tumor boundaries.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Auxiliary Feature Extractor ( 𝒮 a ​ u ​ x \mathcal{S}_{aux} )
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 辅助地物提取器(S a u x\ mathcal{S}_{aux})

blocks.en: To drive the anatomy-prioritized optimization, we utilize an auxiliary network, 𝒮 a ​ u ​ x \mathcal{S}_{aux} , which acts as a frozen expert during the training of G G . This network is pre-trained using only one single real modality as input to ensure that its latent embeddings are highly specialized in the specific anatomical features of each sequence. During the generative phase, 𝒮 a ​ u ​ x \mathcal{S}_{aux} remains strictly frozen and serves as a multi-scale feature extractor. Specifically, to compute the Anatomical Feature-Prioritized ( ℒ A ​ F ​ P \mathcal{L}_{AFP} ) loss Longuefosse et al. (2025) , feature maps are extracted from every level of both the encoder and the decoder, forcing the generator to preserve structural invariants across multiple levels of abstraction. Furthermore, this network provides the topological guidance required for the ℒ D ​ u ​ a ​ l ​ D ​ i ​ c ​ e \mathcal{L}_{DualDice} loss, aligning the synthesized lesion area with the expected clinical morphology.
blocks.zh: 为了推动解剖学优先优化,我们利用了一个辅助网络(S a u x \ mathcal{S}_{aux}),在GG训练期间充当冷冻专家. 这个网络是预先训练的,只使用一种真正的模式作为输入,以确保其潜在的嵌入高度专门化于每个序列的具体解剖特征。 在基因期,S a u x \ mathcal{S}_{aux}仍然保持严格冻结,并充当多尺度特征提取器. 具体地说,为了计算解剖特征优先化(L A F P\mathcal{L}_{AFP})损失Longuefosse et al. (2025),从编码器和解码器的每个级别都提取了特征图,迫使生成器在多个层次的抽象中保存结构变量. 此外,这个网络为L D u a l D i c e \ mathcal{L}_{DualDice}损失提供了所需的地形指导,使综合损伤区与预期的临床形态相一致。

blocks.en: Architecturally, 𝒮 a ​ u ​ x \mathcal{S}_{aux} shares the same nnU-Net ResEnc M configuration and training objective as the final clinical segmenter S S , with the critical distinction that its input layer is configured to accept a single modality channel rather than the full four-channel protocol.
blocks.zh: 建筑学上,S a u x \ mathcal{S}_{aux}与最终临床分机S S 拥有相同的 nnU-Net ResEnc M 配置和培训目标,关键区别在于其输入层的配置是为了接受单一模式通道,而不是完整的四通道协议.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Final Clinical Segmenter ( S S )
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 最终临床分机(西)

blocks.en: The final component of our framework is the clinical segmenter S S , which utilizes the nnU-Net ResEnc M architecture Isensee et al. (2024) to achieve an optimal balance between segmentation performance and computational efficiency. This network is optimized using the standard nnU-Net objective function, combining Dice loss and Cross-Entropy loss in equal proportion. Unlike the auxiliary extractor, this network is trained to process the full complement of four input modalities. To enhance its resilience to synthetic imputation, S S is trained under a specialized augmentation scheme where there is a 50 % 50\% probability that any given modality is replaced by its synthetic counterpart generated by G G . During the inference phase, this network acts as the definitive evaluator, processing the imputed 4-modality protocol to produce the final tumor masks. This configuration ensures that the segmenter is not only capable of interpreting synthetic data but also of integrating it seamlessly with real modalities to maintain high diagnostic accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们框架的最后组成部分是临床分解器S S,它利用nU-Net ResEnc M架构Isensee等人(2024年)实现分解性能和计算效率之间的最佳平衡。 这个网络利用标准的nU-Net客观功能进行优化,将Dice损失和Cross-Entropy损失等比例结合. 与辅助提取器不同,这个网络被训练来处理四个输入模式的完整补充. 为提高SS对合成推算的适应能力,SS在专门增强计划中接受了培训,在这种计划中,任何特定模式都有可能被GG生成的合成对应物所取代。 在推论阶段,这个网络充当明确的评估者,处理推算的4模式协议,以产生最终的肿瘤口罩. 这种配置确保分解器不仅能够解释合成数据,而且能够将其与真实模式无缝结合,以保持高诊断精度.

blocks.en: While ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} ensures global contrast, it lacks the spatial context required to preserve high-frequency structures. To explicitly promote the preservation of fine anatomical details, we employ the Anatomical Feature-Prioritized (AFP) loss, originally proposed for cross-modality translation in Longuefosse et al. blocks.en: 3.4 Implementation and Training Details
blocks.zh: 3.4 实施和培训细节

blocks.en: CAPS is implemented in PyTorch and integrated into the adapted nnU-Netv2 architecture Isensee et al. (2021) ; Longuefosse et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: CAPS在PyTorch实施,并融入了经过改造的nnU-Netv2架构Isensee等人(2021年);Longuefosse等人(2024年).

blocks.en: All MRI volumes were independently normalized using standard Z-score normalization (zero mean, unit variance) per modality. During training, we employed a robust online data augmentation pipeline to prevent overfitting, which included spatial transformations (random rotations and scaling) and intensity transformations (Gaussian noise, Gaussian blur, brightness/contrast adjustments, and gamma correction) Isensee et al. (2021) . Notably, spatial mirroring (flips) was explicitly disabled to preserve the inherent left-right anatomical asymmetries of the brain.
blocks.zh: 所有核磁共振量均采用标准Z-分数正常化(零平均,单位差异)方式独立正常化。 在培训期间,我们采用了一个强大的在线数据增强管道,以防止过度调整,包括空间变换(随机旋转和缩放)和强度变换(高斯噪音、高斯模糊度、亮度/连续调整以及伽马校正) Isensee等人 (2021) (英语). 值得注意的是,空间镜像(flips)被明确禁用,以保持大脑内在的左-右解剖不对称.

blocks.en: The generative model was trained using 3D patches of size 96 × 160 × 160 96\times 160\times 160 voxels and a batch size of 2. The network parameters were optimized using Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) with Nesterov momentum Shi (2024) ( 0.99 0.99 ) and weight decay ( 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} ). The initial learning rate was set to 10 − 2 10^{-2} and progressively decayed according to a polynomial schedule function over the training process.
blocks.zh: 基因模型是使用大小96×160×16096\time160x160 voxels的3D补丁和批量大小2. 网络参数被优化使用Stochastic Gradient Egency(SGD)与Nesterov growth Shi(2024)(0.99 0.99)和重量衰减(3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5}). 初始学习率定为10 - 2 10 - 25 ),在培训过程中按照多名制课程逐渐衰败。

blocks.en: To ensure training stability, especially given the multi-objective nature of our hybrid loss function, we applied gradient clipping. The model was trained for 1000 epochs, with each epoch consisting of 250 iterations. All models were trained on a single NVIDIA A40 GPU (48 GB VRAM).
blocks.zh: 为了确保训练稳定性,特别是考虑到混合损失功能的多目标性质,我们采用了梯度剪切法。 该模型为1000个纪元进行了训练,每个纪元由250个迭代组成. 所有型号都接受了单一NVIDIA A40 GPU(48 GB VRAM)的培训.

blocks.en: During the evaluation phase, the inference was performed using a sliding-window approach with a 50 % 50\% patch overlap Isensee et al. (2021) . To reconstruct the final synthetic modality Y ^ \hat{Y} , we employ a mean aggregation strategy across overlapping patches.
blocks.zh: 在评价阶段,采用滑窗法进行推论,50%的补丁与Isensee等人(2021年)重叠。 为了重建最后的合成方式 Y ^\ hat{Y},我们采用了跨重叠补丁的平均聚合策略。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: This section outlines the experimental configuration utilized to validate CAPS. Initially, the selected neuro-oncological datasets and their respective data partitioning strategies are detailed for both the primary evaluation and the cross-domain inference. Finally, the quantitative evaluation metrics employed to assess both image reconstruction quality and downstream segmentation accuracy are defined.
blocks.zh: 本节概述了用于验证联合呼吁程序的实验配置。 最初,选定的神经肿瘤数据集及其各自的数据分割策略都详细用于初级评价和跨域推论. 最后,界定了用于评估图像重建质量和下游分区精确度的定量评价指标。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Data Partitioning
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和数据分区

blocks.en: To comprehensively train and evaluate our proposal, we utilized the globally recognized Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) datasets Menze et al. (2014) . All multi-parametric MRI sequences (T1n, T1c, T2w, and T2f) across these datasets share a standardized preprocessing pipeline: they are co-registered to the same anatomical template, skull-stripped, and resampled to an isotropic resolution of 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 mm.
blocks.zh: 为了全面训练和评估我们的提议,我们利用了全球公认的脑肿瘤分解数据集Menze等人(2014年)。 在这些数据集上的所有多参数核磁共振序列(T1n,T1c,T2w,和T2f)都共享一个标准化的预处理管道:它们被共同注册到同一个解剖模板,头骨突起,并被重新复制到1×1×1的异构分辨率1×1×1时1×1毫米.

blocks.en: The core development of our method was conducted using the BraTS 2023 Adult Glioma dataset Baid et al. (2021) (conceptually identical to the BraTS 2021 and 2022 cohorts), whose official training set comprises 1251 1251 patient cases. We performed an 80 % − 20 % 80\%-20\% split on this subset: the 80 % 80\% partition was exclusively used to train the generative synthesis network G G , while the remaining 20 % 20\% was strictly reserved for training both the auxiliary feature extractor S a ​ u ​ x S_{aux} and the final clinical segmenter S S , ensuring complete data separation from the generator.

In order to ensure a completely unbiased evaluation, all our quantitative results, ablation studies, and State-of-the-Art comparisons were extracted directly from the official, unseen BraTS Adult Glioma Validation set, which comprises unseen 219 219 patient cases. To guarantee absolute fairness and reproducibility, the downstream segmentation metrics on this validation set were computed and retrieved through the official Synapse automated evaluation platform.
blocks.zh: 为了保证完全不带偏见的评价,我们的所有定量结果、衰减研究和最先进的比较直接摘自官方的、看不见的BrATS成人Glioma验证集,其中包括219,219个病例。 为了保证绝对的公平和可复制性,通过正式的Synapse自动评价平台计算并检索了这一验证集的下游分区指标。

blocks.en: To evaluate the zero-shot robustness of our framework under significant domain shifts, we conducted additional inference on three distinct, unseen neuro-oncological cohorts from the BraTS challenge: 1. BraTS Meningioma LaBella et al. (2023) : 1000 1000 cases featuring structurally distinct, typically benign extra-axial tumors. 2. BraTS Pediatric Glioma Kazerooni et al. (2024) : 99 99 cases, presenting unique developmental brain anatomies and differing tumor morphologies. 3. BraTS Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) Glioma Adewole et al. (2023) : 60 60 cases acquired from diverse, low-resource clinical settings, introducing significant variations in scanner hardware and image quality.
blocks.zh: 为了评价我们的框架在重大域转移下的零射强度,我们对来自BrATS挑战的3个不同的、看不见的神经肿瘤群进行了更多的推论: 1. BrATS Meningioma LaBella等人(2023年): 1 000例病例,其结构独特,典型是良性轴外肿瘤。 2. BratS小儿Glioma Kazerooni等人(2024年):99例,呈现独特的发育性脑解剖和不同的肿瘤形态。 3. BRATS 撒哈拉以南非洲(SSA)Glioma Adewole等人(2023年):60例病例从多种资源匮乏的临床环境获取,对扫描仪硬件和图像质量产生了显著差异。

5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Evaluation of the proposed framework encompasses a rigorous analysis of both synthesis fidelity and clinical utility. Initial experiments establish the performance degradation caused by missing modalities, providing a baseline for the subsequent ablation studies on architecture and loss formulation. Additionally, the results include a comprehensive comparison with state-of-the-art models, alongside a zero-shot generalization analysis and a blinded radiological validation to confirm the diagnostic reliability of the synthesized modality.
blocks.zh: 对拟议框架的评价包括对综合忠诚和临床效用的严格分析。 初步实验确定缺失方式造成的性能退化,为随后的建筑和损失形成研究提供了基准. 此外,结果还包括与最新模型进行全面比较,同时进行零射一般化分析和盲射放射性验证,以确认合成方式的诊断可靠性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Impact of Missing Modalities
blocks.zh: 5.1 失踪方式的影响

blocks.en: Before evaluating the results of CAPS, it is crucial to quantify the clinical and computational impact that the absence of MRI modalities has on automated segmentation systems, detailed in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 在评价CAPS的结果之前,必须量化缺乏核磁共振模式对自动化分解系统的临床和计算影响,详见表1。

blocks.en: The reference model, trained and evaluated on the full protocol of four real modalities, establishes the upper performance bound with a mean Dice coefficient of 86.65 % 86.65\% and a Hausdorff distance (HD95) of 12.07 12.07 mm. On the other hand, the zero-imputation strategy reveals critical network dependencies on specific sequences, identifying the absence of the T1c sequence as the most critical scenario, where the Dice coefficient for the enhancing tumor (ENH) drastically collapses to 14.02 % 14.02\% . Similarly, the missing T2f case disproportionately affects the whole tumor (WT), with its Dice score dropping to 47.66 % 47.66\% due to the loss of contrast in the peritumoral edema regions.
blocks.zh: 参照模型在四种实际模式的全程协议上经过培训和评价,确定最高性能约束,平均剂量系数为86.65% 86.65%,Hausdorff距离(HD95)为12.07 12.07毫米。 另一方面,零成像策略揭示了对特定序列的关键网络依赖性,将T1c序列的缺失确定为最关键的情况,即增强肿瘤(ENH)的Dice系数急剧崩溃到14.02% 14.02% . 同样,缺失的T2f病例也不成比例地影响了整个肿瘤(WT),由于直肠水肿区域失去对比,它的Dice得分下降到47.66% 47.66% 。

blocks.en: Although robust approaches, such as modality dropout training, partially mitigate these declines, these systems operate under a “black-box” paradigm that delivers an isolated segmentation mask without restoring the underlying anatomical volume. This lack of visual evidence prevents neuroradiologists from corroborating the AI-generated segmentation, thus justifying the pressing need for our synthesis framework, which is aimed at preserving structural fidelity alongside diagnostic interpretability.
blocks.zh: 这些系统虽然采取强有力的方法,例如模式辍学培训,部分地缓解了这些下降,但它们在“黑盒”模式下运作,提供孤立的分解面罩,而不恢复基本的解剖量。 缺乏视觉证据使神经辐射学家无法证实人工智能产生的分解,从而证明迫切需要我们的合成框架,其目的是在诊断可解释性的同时保持结构的忠诚。

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation Study: Architecture and Loss
blocks.zh: 5.2 校对研究:建筑和损失

blocks.en: To empirically justify the design choices of our synthesis and segmentation framework, we conducted a comprehensive ablation study where all configurations were evaluated under the missing T1c scenario, as it represents the most critical challenge from an anatomical perspective, according to Table 1 . The architectural and loss decisions derived from this scenario were subsequently applied identically to the remaining three missing modality cases, with final results reported across all scenarios in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 为了在经验上证明我们合成和分解框架的设计选择是正确的,我们进行了一项全面的消化研究,根据缺失的T1c情景对所有配置进行评价,因为从解剖学的角度来看,这是最关键的挑战。 随后,根据这一设想作出的建筑和损失决定同样适用于其余三个缺失模式案件,最后结果报告于表5。

blocks.en: As detailed in Table 2 , we established a baseline using the standard nnU-Net architecture, which yielded a mean Dice coefficient of 70.86 % 70.86\% and a HD95 of 22.55 22.55 mm. The integration of 3D residual blocks (nnResU-Net) facilitated a more robust training optimization, raising the Dice score to 71.99 % 71.99\% . This performance gain is characteristic of residual architectures, which help mitigate gradient degradation in deep 3D networks while preserving high-frequency spatial features. Finally, replacing standard transposed convolutions with a trilinear interpolation decoder effectively mitigated spatial chequerboard artifacts, stabilizing synthesis quality and achieving an optimal NMSE, PSNR and mean dice.

blocks.en: The quantitative results presented in Table 3 and the visual comparisons in Figure 3 underscore the critical importance of our hybrid loss formulation. As observed in Table 3 , optimization relying exclusively on the voxel-level absolute error ( ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} ) yields the poorest segmentation performance, which suggests that purely intensity-based metrics do not prioritize the preservation of essential anatomical structures, treating all voxels with equal weight regardless of their diagnostic relevance.
blocks.zh: 表3中的定量结果和图3中的视觉比较突出表明了我们混合损失表述的极端重要性。 如表3所示,完全依靠 voxel 级绝对误差(L 1 \ mathcal{L}_{1})进行优化,产生最差的分解性能,这表明纯粹基于强度的度量法并不优先保留基本的解剖结构,无论诊断相关性如何,对所有 voxel 进行同等重量的处理.

blocks.en: The introduction of Dice-based components into the objective function leads to a measurable improvement in the mean Dice score of the synthesized images. However, the most robust validation results are achieved only when combining all three terms: ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} , the Anatomical Feature-Prioritized loss ( ℒ A ​ F ​ P \mathcal{L}_{AFP} ), and the ℒ D ​ u ​ a ​ l ​ D ​ i ​ c ​ e \mathcal{L}_{DualDice} , which ensures a synergy between global intensity consistency, deep latent feature alignment, and topological boundary integrity.
blocks.zh: 将基于Dice的组件引入到客观函数中,使得合成图像的平均Dice分数有可衡量的改进. 然而,只有在将L 1\ mathcal{L}_{1},解剖特征优先损失(L A F P\mathcal{L}_{AFP}),以及L Du a l D i c e\mathcal{L}_{DualDice}三个术语合并后,才能取得最强的验证结果,这确保了全球强度一致性,深潜特征一致性,地形边界完整性之间的协同效应.

blocks.en: Qualitatively, Figure 3 demonstrates that ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} -driven reconstructions suffer from significant blurring, particularly at the tumor margins. While intermediate solutions, such as ℒ 1 + A ​ F ​ P \mathcal{L}_{1}+AFP , succeed in producing well-defined boundaries that closely resemble the ground truth, our proposed total loss configuration ( ℒ 1 + ℒ A ​ F ​ P + ℒ D ​ u ​ a ​ l ​ D ​ i ​ c ​ e \mathcal{L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP}+\mathcal{L}_{DualDice} ) consistently provides the superior balance. Specifically for T1c sequences, where the identification of active tumor zones and neoangiogenesis is clinically vital, our framework successfully preserves these intricate anatomical details while simultaneously generating sharp, non-blurry volumes that mirror the target distribution.
blocks.zh: 图3从质量上表明,L 1\ mathcal{L}_{1}-驱动的重建受到显著模糊的影响,特别是在肿瘤边缘。 虽然中间解决方案,如L 1 + A F P\ mathcal{ L}_{1} 成功地产生了与地面真理非常相似的明确界定的边界,但我们提议的完全损失配置(L 1 + L A F P + L D a l D i c e\mathcal{ L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP}+\mathcal{L}_{DualDice}一致提供优等的平衡. 具体地说,对于T1c序列来说,在临床上,确定活跃的肿瘤区和新发病至关重要,我们的框架成功地保存了这些复杂的解剖细节,同时产生尖锐的、非浆液量,以反映目标分布。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Visual Comparison of Loss Configurations. Generated T1c sequences under varying loss configurations for the missing T1c scenario. The purely pixel-wise ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} optimization produces over-smoothed lesions lacking structural definition. While intermediate configurations ( ℒ 1 + ℒ A ​ F ​ P \mathcal{L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP} and variations with partial Dice constraints) yield incremental improvements in boundary demarcation, the proposed hybrid loss ( ℒ 1 + ℒ A ​ F ​ P + ℒ D ​ u ​ a ​ l ​ D ​ i ​ c ​ e \mathcal{L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP}+\mathcal{L}_{DualDice} ) achieves the optimal qualitative balance. It successfully recovers both the sharp anatomical margins and the critical intra-tumoral heterogeneity and the regions of neoangiogenesis, closely mirroring the real T1c target.
blocks.zh: 图3:损失配置的视觉比较。 为缺失的T1c场景在不同的损失配置下生成了T1c序列. 纯像素智能 L 1\ mathcal{L}_{1} 优化产生过度流畅的损伤, 缺乏结构定义 。 虽然中间配置(L1 + L A F P\ mathcal{L}_{1}+\Mathcal{L}_{AFP}以及带有部分Dice限制的变异)使得边界划分逐渐改善,但拟议的混合损失(L1 + L A F P + L Du a l D i c e\mathcal{ L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP}+\mathcal{L}_{DualDice})实现最佳质量平衡. 它成功地恢复了尖锐的解剖边缘和关键的道德内部异质性以及新阳性发病区域,与真正的T1c目标紧密相对应.

blocks.en: Having optimized the image generator G G , we evaluated the most effective strategy for integrating these synthetic volumes into the segmentation network S S . We compared training under varying missing modality ratios (25%, 50%, 75%) using Random Dropout, where the T1c modality is zero-padded with the given probability, against a generative augmentation approach, where the missing T1c is replaced by our model’s synthetic imputation. All configurations were ultimately evaluated in the scenario where the 3 real MRI modalities are available and the T1c modality must be synthesized.
blocks.zh: 在优化了图像生成器GG之后,我们评估了将这些合成量纳入分块网络SS的最有效战略。 我们使用Random Dropout(T1c模式与给定概率为零)将不同模式(25%、50%、75%)下的培训与基因增生法(我们模式的合成推算取代了缺失的T1c)进行比较。 所有配置最终都是在具备3个真实的核磁共振模式且必须合成T1c模式的情景下进行的.

blocks.en: The underlying hypothesis of the Random Dropout strategy is that, by forcing the network to encounter zero-padded T1c channels during training, it will develop fewer dependencies on this specific modality, theoretically improving robustness when it is missing at inference. However, our results demonstrate that this approach is suboptimal, likely due to the inherent domain shift between the training conditions (zero-padded inputs) and the testing conditions (synthesized inputs).
blocks.zh: 随机退学策略的基本假设是,通过强迫网络在训练时遇到零加法的T1c通道,它将发展出对这个特定模式较少的依赖,理论上在推断缺失时会提高稳健性. 然而,我们的结果表明,这种方法不尽人意,可能是由于培训条件(零加成投入)和测试条件(综合投入)之间的内在域转移。

blocks.en: Instead, we observed that explicitly feeding the segmentation network with synthetically imputed volumes during training consistently yields superior performance. Specifically, training the segmenter from scratch with a 50% probability of replacing the real T1c with its synthetic counterpart during training provided the best overall results, particularly in improving the mean Dice coefficient (75.80%).
blocks.zh: 相反,我们发现,在培训期间,用人工估计的体积为分块网络提供明确的信息,始终能产生更好的效果。 具体而言,从零开始培训支线员,在培训期间将真正的T1c替换为合成对应物的概率达到50%,这提供了最佳的总体结果,特别是在提高平均剂量系数(75.80%)方面。

blocks.en: Table 4: Segmenter ( S S ) Training Strategy Ablation. Quantitative evaluation of different training paradigms for the final clinical segmenter under the missing T1c scenario. Using the optimized generator configuration, we explore the impact of varying the probability ratio (25%, 50%, and 75%) of encountering a missing modality during training. The standard Random Dropout (zero-padding) baseline is compared against our proposed synthetic data augmentation, evaluated both by training the segmenter from scratch and by fine-tuning (FT) a pre-trained model. The results demonstrate that training the segmenter from scratch with a 50% probability of synthetic imputation achieves the optimal balance, yielding the highest mean Dice score and validating the utility of generative augmentation for downstream robustness.

blocks.en: Having established the optimal generator architecture G G , hybrid loss formulation through S a ​ u ​ x S_{aux} , and downstream segmentation strategy on S S for the missing T1c scenario, we extended the evaluation of our final framework to all other missing modality cases, presented in Table 5 .

blocks.en: The results confirm that the benefits of our methodology are not isolated to T1c, but generalize exceptionally well to any missing sequence. For instance, in the missing T1n and T2w scenarios, the framework achieves mean Dice scores of 85.90 % 85.90\% and 85.12 % 85.12\% , respectively, alongside high PSNR values ( 28.99 28.99 and 26.18 26.18 ). Even in the missing T2f scenario, which heavily impacts edema delineation, the model successfully restores the peritumoral contrast, yielding a mean Dice of 82.69 % 82.69\% . Overall, our unified framework achieves a highly robust global average Dice of 82.38 % 82.38\% and an HD95 of 15.96 15.96 mm across all missing modality scenarios, solidifying its reliability as a comprehensive imputation tool for incomplete clinical protocols.
blocks.zh: 结果证实,我们方法的好处不是孤立于T1c,而是特别明确地概括于任何缺失序列。 例如,在缺失的T1n和T2w情景中,框架的平均得分分别为85.90%85.90%和85.12%85.12%,同时具有较高的PSNR值(28.99 28.99和26.18 26.18)。 即使在缺失的T2f场景中(该场景严重影响水肿的划定),该模型也成功恢复了直觉对比,得出82.69%的82.69%的平均值。 总体来说,我们的统一框架实现了高度强大的全球平均剂量82.38%82.38\%,以及15.96 15.96mm的HD95,巩固了其可靠性,作为不完全临床协议的全面估算工具。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 5.3 与艺术国家的比较

blocks.en: To comprehensively validate our Synthesis Framework, we compared its performance against recent State-of-the-Art approaches in both image reconstruction quality and downstream segmentation utility.
blocks.zh: 为了全面验证我们的综合框架,我们在图像重建质量和下游分块作用方面,将其业绩与最近的“艺术现状”方法进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 6 presents a quantitative comparison of synthesis quality. A persistent challenge in this domain is the lack of standardized evaluation protocols on the BraTS dataset; existing literature diverges significantly in terms of target missing modalities, data partitioning (e.g., using the official validation set versus reserving an internal 20% held-out split from the training data), and input availability (1-to-1 vs. 3-to-1 synthesis) Li et al. (2024) . Furthermore, the limited availability of public source code for several baselines precludes perfectly matched retraining. To ensure the most rigorous and fair evaluation possible under these constraints, we carefully aligned our testing with the specific conditions reported by each baseline.
blocks.zh: 表6对合成质量进行了定量比较。 该领域的一个持续挑战是,缺乏关于BRATS数据集的标准化评价协议;现有文献在目标缺失模式、数据分割(例如,使用官方验证数据集,而不是从培训数据中保留20%的内存)和输入可用性(1至1对3至1综合)方面差异很大。 李等 (2024) (中文(简体) ). 此外,若干基准的公共源代码有限,因此无法进行完全匹配的再培训。 为了确保在这些限制下进行尽可能严格和公正的评估,我们仔细地根据每个基准报告的具体条件进行测试。

blocks.en: In the official validation split, our volumetric approach significantly outperforms existing 1-to-1 methods (e.g., Pix2Pix Isola et al. (2017) , CycleGAN Zhu et al. (2017) , EaGAN Yu et al. (2019) , ALDM Kim and Park (2024) ), achieving an SSIM of 93.97 % 93.97\% . While this performance gap naturally underscores the substantial advantage of utilizing the full multi-modal context (3-to-1 mapping) inherently supported by our architecture, it also highlights the capacity of our model to effectively integrate complementary information for high-fidelity imputation. To further evaluate our architectural robustness and isolate the effect of input configuration, we compared our method against recent 3-to-1 models, such as AMM-Diff Kebaili et al. (2025a) , under their reported evaluation protocol (a 20% held-out split). Evaluated on this corresponding fraction of unseen data, our method maintains a highly competitive SSIM of 93.88 % 93.88\% . Even though diffusion-based models like AMM-Diff Kebaili et al. (2025a) achieve a marginally higher PSNR, our approach excels in SSIM, demonstrating remarkable structural consistency.
blocks.zh: 在正式的验证拆分中,我们的量学方法大大超过了现有的1比1方法(如Pix2Pix Isola等人(2017年),CycleGAN). Zhu et al. (2017), EaGAN Yu et al. (2019), ALDM Kim and Park (2024), 实现SSIM 93.97% 93.97\%. 虽然这一业绩差距自然突出了利用我们架构内在支持的全多式联运背景(3比1绘图)的巨大优势,但也突出了我们的模型有效整合高可靠性估算补充信息的能力。 为了进一步评价我们的建筑坚固度和隔离输入配置的效果,我们将我们的方法与最近3比1的模型进行比较,例如AMM-Diff Kebaili等人(2025a),这是根据他们报告的评价协议(20%的悬空拆分)。 我们的方法保持了93.88%的高度竞争力。 尽管AMM-Diff Kebaili等人(2025年a)等基于传播的模型实现了略高的PSNR,但我们的方法在SSIM方面却非常出色,显示出显著的结构一致性。

blocks.en: Table 6: State-of-the-Art Comparison of Image Reconstruction Quality. Quantitative synthesis evaluation against existing baselines using standard Image Quality Metrics (IQM), reported as the mean across all evaluated missing modality scenarios within each group. To ensure a fair comparison, methods are grouped according to their specific evaluated missing scenarios and reported data partitions (Official Validation set vs. a 20% held-out split). The results demonstrate that CAPS, our proposed 3-to-1 framework, substantially outperforms traditional 1-to-1 methods and achieves highly competitive structural fidelity (highest SSIM) compared to recent multi-modal diffusion approaches.

Because these models bypass the complex task of image generation and directly optimize boundary predictions from incomplete data, their purely computational metrics are higher. However, as previously discussed, this comes at the severe cost of clinical interpretability, outputting isolated masks without the underlying anatomical context.

When compared to the available synthesis-based joint models that do provide these metrics, such as the recent work by Ferreira et al. Ferreira et al. (2026) . CAPS deliberately trades this purely computational advantage for a critical gain in clinical interpretability. By explicitly enforcing structural and topological consistency via our hybrid loss, we deliver highly verifiable anatomical restorations alongside robust tumor delineations. This approach ensures that neuroradiologists have the necessary visual evidence to validate the predictions of our method.

blocks.en: A critical limitation of many medical deep learning frameworks is their susceptibility to domain shift. Models trained on a specific cohort often experience severe performance degradation when exposed to Out-of-Distribution (OoD) data Diana-Albelda et al. (2026) . To validate the robustness of our framework, we evaluated its zero-shot inference capabilities on three completely unseen datasets from the BraTS challenge: Meningioma LaBella et al. (2023) , Pediatric Glioma Kazerooni et al. (2024) , and Sub-Saharan African Glioma Adewole et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 许多医学深层学习框架的一个关键限制是它们容易发生领域转移。 接受过特定群体培训的模型在接触Diana-Albelda等人(2026年)的Out-discription(OoD)数据时,往往出现严重性能退化。 为了验证我们框架的稳健性,我们评价了它对BratS挑战中三个完全看不见的数据集的零射推论能力:Meningioma LaBella等人(2023年)、Pediatric Glioma Kazerooni等人(2024年)和撒哈拉以南非洲Glioma Adewole等人(2023年)。

blocks.en: Each of these datasets introduces unique morphological and technical challenges. Meningiomas are tumors that typically tend to compress rather than infiltrate surrounding brain tissue, presenting a fundamentally different topology than adult gliomas Fathi and Roelcke (2013) . Pediatric Gliomas involve developing brains with distinct myelination patterns and tumor presentations Duffau (2022) . Finally, the Sub-Saharan African Glioma cohort introduces significant technical variability, featuring scans acquired from diverse hardware and protocols typical of low-resource clinical settings Boonzaier et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 每一个数据集都引入了独特的形态和技术挑战. Meningiomas是通常会压缩而不是渗透到脑组织周围的肿瘤, 小儿Gliomas(小儿Gliomas)涉及培养脑部具有明显的迷宫图案和肿瘤演示. Duffau(2022). 最后,撒哈拉以南非洲Glioma组采用了重大的技术变异性,其特点是从资源低的临床环境典型的各种硬件和协议中获取扫描(2025年)。

blocks.en: As reported in Table 8 , the framework demonstrates robust generalization despite these substantial domain shifts. Notably, the average synthesis quality on the three unseen cohorts (PSNR ranging from 26.24 to 26.42; NMSE from 0.0318 to 0.0412) remains closely aligned with the in-distribution Adult Glioma performance reported in Table 5 (PSNR = 26.96; NMSE = 0.0351). Furthermore, the narrow spread across the three external datasets indicates that the fidelity of our method is not contingent on a specific tumor morphology or acquisition protocol. Downstream segmentation metrics are intentionally omitted for these cross-domain cohorts for two reasons. First, the BraTS Meningioma dataset employs a fundamentally different tumor annotation protocol, rendering segmentation predictions from our Adult Glioma-trained segmenter S S inapplicable. Second, for the Pediatric and Sub-Saharan cohorts, reporting segmentation accuracy would conflate two independent sources of performance variation: synthesis fidelity and segmenter generalization, thereby preventing a clean assessment of the generator’s cross-domain robustness, which is the specific focus of this evaluation.

blocks.en: Despite these promising results, the current method presents certain limitations, particularly its decoupled two-stage structure and its reliance on a specific pre-trained segmentation network. To address these constraints, future research could focus on the development of a unified, end-to-end architecture that leverages anatomy-prioritized constraints within a single joint framework, potentially further closing the accuracy-interpretability gap. Additionally, other promising avenues for investigation include adapting the framework to accommodate dynamic input configurations (e.g., 1-to-1 or 2-to-1 synthesis) and extending this anatomy-prioritized paradigm to other complex oncological domains, such as multi-parametric prostate Armato III et al. (2018) or liver MRI. Finally, although the clinical validation confirms the diagnostic utility of the synthesized volumes, the assessment was performed by a single radiologist, so future studies may incorporate multiple experts to robustly assess inter-rater reliability.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些有希望的结果,但目前的方法存在某些局限性,特别是其两阶段结构脱钩,并依赖于一个经过预先培训的具体分块网络。 为了解决这些制约因素,未来的研究可以侧重于开发一个统一的、端到端的架构,在一个单一的联合框架内利用解剖学优先化的制约因素,从而可能进一步缩小准确性-可解释性的差距。 此外,其他有希望的调查途径包括调整框架,以适应动态输入配置(如1–1或2–1合成),并将这种解剖学优先化的范式扩展到其他复杂的肿瘤领域,如多参数前列腺III等人(2018年)或肝脏核磁共振. 最后,虽然临床验证证实了合成体卷的诊断效用,但评估是由一位放射学家进行的,因此未来的研究可能包括多名专家,以有力地评估研究者之间的可靠性.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented a Clinically-Verifiable Anatomy-Prioritized Synthesis framework (CAPS) to address the critical challenge of missing MRI modalities in neuro-oncological imaging Chrysochoou et al. (2026) . Traditional approaches to this problem typically force a compromise between computational accuracy and diagnostic transparency: robust segmenters predict tumor boundaries while leaving clinicians blind to the underlying anatomy Zhang et al. (2022) ; Pipoli et al. (2025) , whereas standard synthesis models reconstruct images that lack the structural fidelity required for clinical trust Longuefosse et al. (2025) . By driving our 3D generative architecture with a hybrid objective function ( ℒ 1 + ℒ A ​ F ​ P + ℒ D ​ u ​ a ​ l ​ D ​ i ​ c ​ e \mathcal{L}_{1}+\mathcal{L}_{AFP}+\mathcal{L}_{DualDice} ), we successfully bridged this gap, enforcing the preservation of deep anatomical features and strict topological boundaries.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了可临床验证的解剖学优先合成框架(CAPS),以应对神经-肿瘤成像Chrysochoou等人(2026年)中缺失的核磁共振模式的关键挑战。 解决这一问题的传统方法通常迫使计算准确性与诊断透明度之间达成妥协:强分仪预测肿瘤边界,同时使临床医生对基本的解剖学Zhang等人(2022年)视而不见;Pipoli等人(2025年),而标准合成模型重建的图像缺乏临床信任所需的结构忠诚性Longuefosse等人(2025年). 通过驱动我们具有混合目标功能的3D基因架构(L 1 + L A F P + L D u a l D i c e mathcal{) 我们成功地弥合了这一差距,强制保护了深刻的解剖特征和严格的地形界限。

blocks.en: Our comprehensive evaluation on the BraTS Adult Glioma dataset Baid et al. (2021) demonstrated that our framework significantly outperforms existing State-of-the-Art synthesis methods with a highly competitive downstream segmentation mean Dice score of 82.38 % 82.38\% . Beyond standard computational metrics, our approach exhibited exceptional zero-shot generalization capabilities across completely unseen and morphologically distinct domains, including Meningioma LaBella et al. (2023) , Pediatric Kazerooni et al. (2024) , and Sub-Saharan African Adewole et al. (2023) cohorts. Most importantly, a blinded radiological evaluation confirmed that our anatomy-aware synthesis substantially improves both perceived image quality and clinical utility, providing human experts with the verifiable visual context needed to trust downstream automated segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们对BratS Adult Glioma数据集Baid等人(2021年)的全面评价表明,我们的框架大大超过了现有的具有高度竞争性的下游分化的艺术状态合成方法,这意味着Dice得分82.38% 82.38%。 除了标准计算指标外,我们的方法还显示出超乎寻常的零射一般化能力,跨越完全看不见和形态上截然不同的领域,包括Meningioma LaBella等人(2023年)、小儿科Kazerooni等人(2024年)和撒哈拉以南非洲Adewole等人(2023年)。 最重要的是,一项盲目的放射性评估证实,我们的解剖意识合成大大改善了人们所感知的图像质量和临床效用,为人类专家提供了相信下游自动分解所需的可核查的视觉环境。
